h1.text:
ANSWERED · TURNING IN (checked live, 7 Oct)

• Only some work has a Schoology dropbox. Chemistry 'Scan PDF' homework uses it. AP Bio has none: labs are turned in on the teacher's lab site. Most other work is paper.
• Algebra 2 has dropboxes but grades paper: HW #13 is 5/5 with nothing submitted. So 'not submitted' ≠ missing. Learn it per class and grey the card.
• Schoology's overdue list = unsubmitted dropbox work + quizzes. HW #18 (Algebra 2) shows as overdue though it's likely on paper. Paper work never shows as overdue.
• Google Assignments ARE used in US History (Quick Writes, Reconstruction Revolution packet), marked by lti-app-grading on <body> + an /external_tool/ iframe. The parser now flags them (S4 done). Schoology never says if you turned one in, so: 'Open in Schoology ↗' + manual mark.
• Quizzes come as /course/…/assessments/…: never open by itself.

h2.text:
ANSWERED · GRADES DATA

• Comments: real and sometimes long (English 10 paragraph, 'added 0.5 to factoring', 'score (104.45) capped at 100').
• Grade cells can be '—Collected' (an exception word after a dash). Missing will likely look the same: '—Missing'. Parse that word.
• Scores: extra credit over 100% (25/24), 0/0 items, raw + curved duplicates. Never divide by 0; show >100% as is.
• Scales differ: Chemistry tops out at 'A (100%)', others say A+. US History shows 'A- (92%)', so its A line is above 92. Use 93 as 'about', narrowed by the letter/% pairs seen in that class; let the user set it.
• Skip the empty '(no grading period)' block.
• Refresh: ~15 requests for everything (1 courses + 2 home lists + 6 gradebooks + 6 feeds) + 1 per open dropbox item.

h3.text:
DECIDED · YOUR OWN STATE

• The app keeps Done / Studied / Turned in / type locally (SwiftData), so it works with no neo-plan. Connecting neo-plan stays fully supported (same token and ops as the extension); once connected, app, extension and website share one copy.
• HW vs TEST without neo-plan: from the gradebook category (Tests, Quiz, Tests/Quizzes, Summatives) and title words (Exam, Quiz, Interro). neo-plan's type wins when connected.
• Conflicts with the extension: neo-plan's newer edit wins. Offline taps queue and send later.
• Bad due dates exist: Spanish 'Prueba: pretérito o imperfecto' is due in 2025 (teacher typo) and shows as a year overdue. Hide overdue > 60 days behind 'Older'.
• Refresh: To Do on open + pull (3 requests); a class's gradebook when you open it or every 30 min; dropbox checks only for unsubmitted dropbox rows; feed only on Updates.

h4.text:
STILL OPEN · needs the app running

S1 Upload: open Chemistry HW 10/7's Submit dialog in the sheet and attach a photo + a PDF. Don't press Submit unless it's real homework.
DONE: S2 rubric source (two /iapi JSON GETs), S4 Google Assignment markup.
Also test with S1: does a Google Assignment's cross-site frame load inside the sheet (iOS third-party cookies)?
S3 Google Docs: check the Docs app opens a docs.google.com link (universal link) and has the school account.

STILL TO DECIDE
• Not designed: Updates feed, messages, calendar, dark mode, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver for swipes, iPad.
• App name and icon.
• Free account: rebuild every 7 days; local notifications only.

n1a.text:
1a TO DO · build first

SHOWS: everything due, grouped by class in Course Dashboard order. Overdue in red with days late. The 3 counts at the top filter the list.

DATA: the home page's upcoming + overdue lists, plus the app's own list (see h3). Schoology's overdue list only holds dropbox work and quizzes: paper work drops off once it's past due, so the app keeps it until you tick it. Type: Test if its gradebook category says Test/Quiz/Exam/Summative, else HW; neo-plan overrides.

TAPS: circle = Done (square = Studied). Submit ↗ only on dropbox work (1c). Swipe left = Mark turned in + the class's real turn-in place (Schoology, a lab site, or none for paper). Row → 1b. Pull = refresh. Gear → 4b.

n1b.text:
1b ASSIGNMENT

DATA: assignment page (parseAssignment) + dropbox (submitted, late, revisions) + gradebook (category, score, comment).

SUBMISSION card, one of four:
• Dropbox, used by the class → Submitted / Not submitted, with when it was checked.
• Dropbox, but the class grades paper (graded items with nothing submitted, like Algebra 2) → grey 'Not used by this class'.
• No dropbox → 'Turned in outside Schoology'; if the instructions link a submit page (AP Bio lab site) show that as the ↗ button.
• Quiz (/assessments/) → 'Take on Schoology ↗' only on your tap.
• Google Assignment (empty body, US History) → 'Open in Schoology ↗'.
'Mark as turned in' is always there and only changes your list.

n1c.text:
1c SCHOOLOGY SHEET · one reusable component

A WKWebView in a sheet, same login. Used for submit, quizzes, discussions and every 'Open in Schoology'; the same sheet opens outside pages (lab site, Google Docs fallback).

Done closes it and re-checks the dropbox; if it now says submitted: toast + clear.

UPLOAD: iOS web views show the Photos / Camera / Files menu for a file input with no extra code. Info.plist needs NSCameraUsageDescription or 'Take Photo' crashes. Still to test once on Schoology's real Submit dialog (spike S1).

n2a.text:
2a GRADES

DATA: each course's gradebook page (parseGrades) + grademath (distance to A, graph, +/- effect of each score).

CARD: letter + %, small graph, distance to the A line, latest score and its effect. Tap → 2b.
RECENTLY GRADED: newest scores across all classes. Needs a saved copy of the last fetch to know what's new.

NOT DRAWN: a class with no grades yet, pass/fail or ungraded classes, other terms.

n2b.text:
2b COURSE GRADES

Every item: score, %, date, effect on the grade, plus Comment / Rubric markers when Schoology has them. Categories show weight and 'A holds down to'. Row → 2c.

WHAT-IF (button, top right) switches on what-if mode: ungraded rows get an input, 'Plan an upcoming test' lives there. Off by default.

DATA: gradebook rows already include a comment column (parseGrades). Rubrics only appear as a button (spike S2). Scores can be over 100% (25/24) or 0/0; grade cells can say '—Collected'.

n2c.text:
2c GRADED WORK

Score, teacher comment (can be a long paragraph: English 10), rubric, submitted files, effect on the course grade. What-if is a small link.

DATA: gradebook row (score, comment) + dropbox (grade, comments, revisions, files). Drop system comments such as 'Revision 1 submitted'.

RUBRIC: most 'rubrics' are attached Google Docs or PDFs (Spanish, US History): list them from the assignment's attachments. Schoology rubrics ARE used (US History, Enlightenment Annotations 4.6/5). S2 done: parseGrades now returns rubric ids; criteria come from /iapi/grades/rubric/{id} + /iapi/grades/rubric_grade_info/{id}/{item}/{enrollment} (JSON; rubric.js parses them). Show each criterion: points, level text, comment.

[Brackets] = placeholder text.

n3a.text:
3a CLASSES

Tiles in Course Dashboard order: grade + open work (matstate counts). Colours are ours (Schoology has none); period label from the section title if there is one.

SEARCH: every class's materials by name (like the MCP's find_material). That walks every Materials tree, so keep a cached index.

UPDATES tile = announcements: SCREEN NOT DESIGNED.
RECENTLY OPENED = local history.

n3b.text:
3b MATERIALS

Folders with open-work status and score (matstate). 'Only open work' toggle works.

EVERY ITEM SAYS WHERE IT OPENS
• Assignment → 1b ›
• PDF, Word, PowerPoint, image → 3c ›
• Google Doc / Slides / Sheet → Google's app if installed, else the in-app browser (already signed in from the school login) ↗
• Other link → in-app browser ↗
• Quiz, discussion → 1c ↗

Materials / Grades / Updates switch for the class. Save-a-class-offline: left out of v1.

n3c.text:
3c FILE VIEWER

The app downloads the file with the Schoology login, then shows it natively (PDFKit / QuickLook): Find, Mark up, Save to Files, Share. QuickLook also covers Word, PowerPoint and images.

Opened files are cached so they work offline.

Google Docs are NOT shown here: they open in Google's app if installed, else the in-app browser.

n3d.text:
3d SCHOOLOGY TAB

The full website in a WKWebView, for everything that isn't native: messages, calendar, groups, discussions, profile.

Bottom bar: back, forward, reload, share. When the page is something the app has a screen for (assignment, gradebook, materials), a pill offers 'Open in app'.

Shares one cookie store with the hidden engine and the sheets.

n4a.text:
4a FIRST LAUNCH

1 Sign in (required): fuhsd.schoology.com in a web view → Google SSO. Switches to the Safari user agent by itself if Google refuses (docs/ios/IOS-APP.md).
2 neo-plan (optional): paste the token or scan a QR code from the extension. Kept in Keychain.
3 Reminders (optional): asks for notification permission.

APP NAME: not decided (can't be 'Schoology').

n4b.text:
4b SETTINGS (gear on To Do)

Schoology account + sign out. neo-plan: status, token, class matching (same as the extension's settings panel). Reminders: evening-before time, new grades (best effort). Accent colour. Login compatibility mode. This build's expiry (free Apple account: 7 days).

n4c.text:
4c SHARED STATES · every screen needs these

First load (skeleton rows) · Offline: show the last copy and how old it is · Signed out by Schoology · Couldn't read the page: a parser broke, so offer Schoology's page, never a blank screen · neo-plan not connected · Nothing due.

rule.text:
THE RULE FOR THE WHOLE APP

Native screens READ Schoology and keep YOUR OWN state: done, studied, marked turned in, neo-plan type, what-if.

Anything that CHANGES Schoology (submit, take a quiz, post in a discussion, a Google Assignment) happens on the real page, in the Schoology sheet (1c). The app watches for 'Submitted' when there's a dropbox; for paper or lab-site work you mark it yourself.

CHECK MARKS
Filled blue = you marked it done
Filled green = Schoology shows a submission (dropbox work only)
Outline green = you marked it turned in (paper, elsewhere)
Square = a test (Studied / not)
Dashed = not in neo-plan yet

ARROWS
› = opens a screen in the app
↗ = opens Schoology or a website
